meta.title: The 3 Things I Can’t Travel Without.
meta.description:
Buy the travel essentials I mentioned here! https://carrot.link/theironsnail/travel-essentials?ref=quick-copy

Oh Denmark! A lovely little country. A country where my good ol' pal Taylor is currently living and going to school. Where specifically in Denmark you may ask? Well, Copenhagen! A nice little city. Anyways join me on a trip to Copenhagen and see what my essentials are for packing. I've only left the United States once but this is definitely in my top 2 favorite countries. Now travel is my thing, my entire personality. I love it. Take me abroad.

TAH TAH!

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
